pages.title: Blaze Burner and Heat
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Some recipes need heat from a **Blaze Burner**.
- Capture a living blaze in an **Empty Blaze Burner**.
- Fuel makes it **heated**. A **Blaze Cake** makes it **superheated**.
- It cools down when its fuel runs out.

Some recipes need **heat**. Create gets it from the **Blaze Burner**, which also boosts [#](2E5AAC)[basin](entry://create_basics/processing)[#]() recipes and powers steam engine [#](7A3C9A)[boilers](entry://glossary/boiler)[#]().\
\
The burner is not crafted whole: you capture a living blaze in an **Empty Blaze Burner**.

pages.title: Empty Blaze Burner
pages.text: Right-click a blaze with it to capture the blaze. Blazes can also be collected from their spawners. Then put the burner under a basin or boiler.
The burner under the basin heats it for mixer recipes marked heated.

pages.title: Blaze Burner
pages.text: Feed it flammable items by hand, or let a [#](2E5AAC)[deployer](entry://create_basics/deployer)[#]() or mechanical arm do it. It cools down when its fuel runs out.

**Two levels**:

- Fed with fuel it is [#](7A3C9A)[heated](entry://glossary/heated)[#]().
- Fed a **Blaze Cake** it becomes [#](7A3C9A)[superheated](entry://glossary/superheated)[#](), the stronger tier some recipes need.

A superheated burner also counts as heated.

pages.title: Blaze Cake
pages.text: Takes a burner to the stronger tier. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() (R, U) for its recipe and the recipes that need superheating.

**What uses heat**:

- Mixer and press recipes marked heated or superheated

- Steam engine boilers: fluid tanks sitting on a burner heat water to steam

- Fans: see [#](2E5AAC)[Encased Fans](entry://create_basics/fans)[#]() for what counts as a fan catalyst.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Other mods**: the [#](7A3C9A)[tag](entry://glossary/tags)[#]() Create reads for boiler heat also includes [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]()'s **Stove**, [#](2E5AAC)[Twilight Forest](entry://exploration/twilight_forest)[#]()'s fiery storage blocks, and lava, magma blocks, campfires and fire. These work as [#](7A3C9A)[passive boiler heaters](entry://glossary/passive_heater)[#](), weaker than a burner.
Burners can also burn liquid fuel from pipes: see [#](2E5AAC)[Burning Liquid Fuel](entry://industry/liquid_fuel)[#]().
